svg.title: Enuna Federation Merchant - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 44-45, PDF 45-46. Combined two-deck projection follows broad rectangular lower working/fuel deck and short rounded aft side drive fairings. Narrow upper accommodation deck is contained. Illustration corroborates slab-sided stepped merchant hull; enclosed docking and cargo space remain solid projection, not holes. No room borders traced.
